summary.headline: Lords of the Ninth and Tenth Houses
summary.text: Chapter XVI interprets the lord of the ninth house in each of the twelve places, describing journeys, learning, inheritance, family, illness, marriage, fatherhood, status, longevity, faith, and enemies. Chapter XVII begins the corresponding interpretation of the lord of the tenth, including favor from princes and renown when placed in the ascendant.
